phase_4_1_report.summary: PR #2014 rebalances two CI test shards by moving 4 module-id tokens (installer-wiring, parallel-suite-runner, tier1-rename-migration, experiment-records) from modules-rest into modules-large in lib/test/run-shard.sh's _shard_modules(). Pure data movement between two existing shard-group string literals; no control flow, shard name, order, or printf format changed.
phase_4_1_report.correctness: Union invariant verified directly: 20 unique modules across shards exactly matching scripts/workflow-flight-recorder-registry.json test_modules, zero duplicates. --list-shards emits same 5 names in same order (monolith, python-pool, modules-pin, modules-large, modules-rest). #877 assertions in run.sh are membership-agnostic (union==registry set-equality + raw-count no-duplicate) and remain green. No module dropped or run twice.
phase_4_1_report.spec_compliance: AC1 SATISFIED (union==registry, no dups, #877 covered). AC2 SATISFIED (shard names/order unchanged). AC3 SATISFIED with one wording inaccuracy (all 19 pre-change modules carry measured durations, source run 32994517846 named, assignment stated; but 'closest to equal-split target' is overclaimed). AC4 SATISFIED (post-change rest 208.62s / large 213.37s, diff 4.75s <= 30s; arithmetic recomputed and confirmed, one 0.01s rounding artifact on large_total immaterial).
phase_4_1_report.verdict_rationale: Change is minimal, correct, fully covered by existing invariant tests, and satisfies all four acceptance criteria. The single finding is a Low-severity wording inaccuracy in the PR description's optimality claim, which does not gate merge (AC4 is a <=30s bound, comfortably met, not a strict optimum).

phase3_findings.description: PR description states the moved set is the subset 'closest to the equal-split target', but exhaustive subset-sum over the 14 rest modules shows an exact 0.0s balance and multiple subsets beat the chosen 4.75s diff. The optimality wording is inaccurate; substance of AC3/AC4 is met. Binds PR description only; no code defect. Suggest softening to e.g. 'a subset that balances the two shards to within ~5s'.

diff_profile.characterization: trivial: 4 tokens moved between two shard-group string literals; module union unchanged

checklist_note: Diff yields one substantive verifiable claim (shard-module union unchanged / no duplicates); verified directly against run-shard.sh --modules-of output and the registry (20 unique == 20 registered, 0 dups). No checklist item failed or was inconclusive.
